DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and

C. FAILURE-PATHWAY INCIDENCE -- code strictly from the DOCUMENTED OUTCOME at the
3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

## Outcome window (fixed at construction)
- The outcome window for this case is fixed at the 3-5 years following the ~2018 closing, i.e. fiscal years ~2021 through ~2023. Facts are cited only within, or explicitly labeled relative to, that window.

## Realized public record after closing
- The registrant (CIK 1455650) filed a Form 15-12G to deregister its common stock (Commission File No. 000-54671) on February 1, 2018, terminating its registration and periodic-reporting obligations as NorthStar Real Estate Income Trust, Inc. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-18-029425, Form 15-12G filed 2018-02-01]
- No annual report (Form 10-K or 20-F) was filed under CIK 1455650 covering any fiscal year within the fixed ~2021-2023 outcome window; the most recent annual report filed under this CIK covers fiscal year 2019 and was filed March 30, 2020. [SRC: SEC EDGAR filing index for CIK 1455650 (Form 10-K list); SEC accession 0001455650-20-000004, Form 10-K FY2019]
- The only continuing SEC registrant under this CIK after the deregistration was a residual liquidation vehicle, N1 Liquidating Trust, whose "sole asset is the Junior Participation, which has an outstanding principal balance of $85.2 million as of March 27, 2020" — a subordinated interest in a single first-mortgage loan collateralized by certain retail properties in the Southeast United States; the Trust "was formed to liquidate the Junior Participation." [SRC: SEC accession 0001455650-20-000004, Form 10-K FY2019] (This is the closest available post-close record and falls OUTSIDE the fixed ~2021-2023 window; it also covers only a single carved-out asset, not the assembled portfolio.)

## Outcome assessment
- The assembled commercial-real-estate portfolio did not continue as a separately reporting public entity into the fixed ~2021-2023 outcome window: the registrant ceased separate public reporting at the February 2018 deregistration, and no public annual report attributable to the registrant or its former portfolio exists within the fixed window. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-18-029425, Form 15-12G filed 2018-02-01; SEC EDGAR filing index for CIK 1455650]
- Any post-2018 trajectory of the former portfolio would be embedded in the consolidated results of the surviving combined entity, which does not separately disclose the acquired business's standalone trajectory in publicly retrievable segment reporting; per the no-record rule, the outcome is therefore not inferred from those consolidated results. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-18-029391, 8-K Item 5.01 (surviving-entity identity only); no separate segment disclosure retrieved]
- OUTCOME: **uncertain** — there is no separate public 3-5-year (~2021-2023) record for this business, which was absorbed at closing into the surviving combined entity and deregistered; the outcome cannot be sourced within the fixed window and is not manufactured. [SRC: SEC accession 0001193125-18-029425, Form 15-12G filed 2018-02-01; SEC accession 0001455650-20-000004, Form 10-K FY2019]

[SLICE END]
